scripts.dev:setup: npm run copy-images && npm run copy-wasm && npm run copy-static-assets && npm run copy-basis-transcoder
scripts.copy-images: mkdir -p public/home-design/images && cp -r ../static/images/graphics public/home-design/images/ && cp -r ../static/images/kreativLite public/home-design/images/
scripts.copy-wasm: mkdir -p public/wasm && cp ../node_modules/@geomagical/sugarcube-rendering-shared/dist/release/decorate-engine.wasm public/ && cp ../node_modules/@geomagical/sugarcube-shared/dist/kreativ-core-sdk.wasm public/wasm/kreativ-core-sdk.wasm
scripts.copy-basis-transcoder: mkdir -p public/basis && cp ../node_modules/three/examples/jsm/libs/basis/basis_transcoder.js public/basis/ && cp ../node_modules/three/examples/jsm/libs/basis/basis_transcoder.wasm public/basis/
